_note: Economics Menu options, exact ranges/defaults from the label/range/default table L1759-L1818.

interestRate.label: Interest Rate
interestRate.description: Unspent money in the bank earns interest each round; rate also affects the cost of repeated-use items such as Auto-Defense.

cashAtStart.label: Cash at Start
cashAtStart.description: Starting money per player; non-zero gives a buying pass before round 1.
cashAtStart._defaultNote: OG INITIAL_CASH = 1000000 (data/og-defaults.json) — the original game seeded each player with $1,000,000 to start; the manual's default column lists $0 but the OG defaults file is the real intended value, so players can buy ammo/accessories from round 1. Editor-tunable; range max matches this value.

computersBuy.label: Computers Buy
computersBuy.description: Whether computer-controlled tanks may buy items.

freeMarket.label: Free Market
freeMarket.description: Supply-and-demand pricing: frequently-bought items get pricier, ignored items cheaper; state persisted in scorch.mkt.

scoringMode.label: Scoring Mode
scoringMode.description: BASIC: points only for kills and surviving. STANDARD: fewer kill points, points for damage. GREEDY: like STANDARD but round rankings by Net Worth (cash + depreciated stock).

selling.baseFactorNote: The manual gives NO exact sell formula or fixed percentage — only 'you must usually accept a loss' (L877) and per-quantity computer offers (L865-L867). null = unknowable from source; do not invent.

rules.rule: Computer makes an offer per selected quantity; price per item may vary with quantity sold.
Offers persist until the next round (possibly longer).
Selling usually incurs a loss (depreciation), except with Free Market on, where buy-low/sell-high profit is possible.
Free-market prices follow supply/demand with damped oscillation ('bouncing') toward a new equilibrium.

interestDrift.note: Only quantitative depreciation hint in the manual: GREEDY rankings use 'the depreciated value of all weapons, etc. in stock'; the rate is never specified.

buyBackMarkup.note: Related buying rule: at the 99-per-item cap, partial bundles are remade at ~20% markup (e.g. $5,000/5 becomes $6,000/5).

battle._note: Battle creation cash seed (pre-W4-D documented seed; the manual pins no starting-cash default — Cash at Start default is a separate settings row). W5 purge: turnState.js reads this; no JS fallback exists.

freeMarketDrift._note: Free Market drift magnitudes (manual pins DIRECTIONS only). Derived from the observed SCORCH.MKT fieldA/fieldB ranges; _placeholder, never presented as manual values. W5 purge: economy.js reads this; no JS fallback exists.
